claude_proposed_widenings.name: activated_choice_family
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Channel Divinity is an activated ability that presents N sub-effect procedures (Divine Spark, Turn Undead) sharing a single resource pool. The player chooses one at activation time. No existing mechanics family supports 'choose one of N activation subgraphs consuming a shared resource.' ActivatedAbilityMechanics has a linear phases[] with no top-level branching; CompositeClassFeatureMechanics means simultaneous parts not mutually exclusive choice; CastTimeEffectModeChoice is (a) within a direct phase only and (b) restricted to EffectAtom branches, not full activation phases.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Each time you use this class's Channel Divinity, choose which Channel Divinity effect from this class to create.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: CastTimeEffectModeChoice branches into ActivationPhase
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Divine Spark's caster-time choice between 'heal' and 'save-gated damage' requires one branch to be a save_gate phase. CastTimeEffectModeChoice.options[].effects is ReadonlyNonEmptyArray<EffectAtom>, which cannot contain an ActivationPhase (save_gate). The two branches differ in resolution structure, not just effect atoms.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Roll 1d8 and add your Wisdom modifier. You either restore Hit Points to the creature equal to that total or force the creature to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes Necrotic or Radiant damage (your choice) equal to that total.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: DurationEndTrigger.caster_becomes_incapacitated
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Turn Undead's 1-minute duration ends early if the caster gains the Incapacitated condition. No such caster-state trigger variant exists in DurationEndTrigger. All existing variants are target-side (target_makes_attack_roll, target_deals_damage, target_casts_spell, target_dons_armor, target_damaged_by_caster_or_ally, target_takes_damage, caster_recasts_spell).
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: This effect ends early on the creature if it takes any damage, if you have the Incapacitated condition, or if you die.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: DurationEndTrigger.caster_dies
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Turn Undead's 1-minute duration ends early if the caster dies. No such caster-death trigger variant exists in DurationEndTrigger.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: This effect ends early on the creature if it takes any damage, if you have the Incapacitated condition, or if you die.
